## Summary

Describe the change and link the issue it resolves.

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring or maintenance
- [ ] Breaking change (include migration guidance)

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the repository conventions.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and pass with 100% coverage locally.
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm run lint` pass.
- [ ] Relevant pages in `docs/` are updated.
- [ ] Commits use `#<issue number>: <imperative title>` and explain what and why.
